title: Assessing Safety of Cervical Spine Fusion With NMP®
official: Assessing Safety of Cervical Spine Fusion With NMP® Graft Material: A Retrospective Chart Review
summary: The goal of this retrospective chart review study is to assess safety of NMP® in the treatment of cervical spine degenerative conditions by assessing the incidence and nature of AEs in follow-up (minimum of 90 days and up to 2 year post-operatively) as well as reoperation rates.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Patients treated with NMP® for Cervical (C2-T1) Interbody fusion (2022-2025) at the study site.
2. Minimum of 90-day post-operative follow up data available

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with no follow-up data within 3 months from the surgery date due to missed postoperative appointments.
